t: 在伦敦怀特霍尔宫为伊丽莎白公主和帕拉特人弗雷德里克五世举行婚礼.
te: Wedding of Princess Elizabeth and Frederick V of the Palatinate at Whitehall Palace, London.
dz: 在伦敦怀特霍尔宫为伊丽莎白公主和帕拉特人弗雷德里克五世举行婚礼.
de: Wedding of Princess Elizabeth and Frederick V of the Palatinate at Whitehall Palace, London.

t: 米哈伊尔一世被国民大会一致选举为沙皇,开始了帝国俄国的罗曼诺夫王朝.
te: Mikhail I is unanimously elected Tsar by a national assembly, beginning the Romanov dynasty of Imperial Russia.
dz: 米哈伊尔一世被国民大会一致选举为沙皇,开始了帝国俄国的罗曼诺夫王朝.
de: Mikhail I is unanimously elected Tsar by a national assembly, beginning the Romanov dynasty of Imperial Russia.

dz: 塞缪尔·阿尔加尔在弗吉尼亚州帕萨帕坦齐抓获了宝嘉康蒂后,与她一起出发去詹姆斯敦,意图将她交换出被她父亲关押的英国囚犯.
de: Samuel Argall, having captured Pocahontas in Passapatanzy, Virginia, sets off with her to Jamestown with the intention of exchanging her for English prisoners held by her father.
